cost_cases.ZERO: Remove $0.05/share/leg/side slippage and $0.65/contract/leg/side commissions from both entry and exit cashflows; capacity recomputed with friction-free entry cashflow.
cost_cases.STRESS: Increase slippage to $0.10/share/leg/side, commission unchanged; capacity recomputed with stressed entry cashflow.

periods.ALL_2018_2025: All 28 observed event signals; episode metrics are not compounded portfolio performance.
periods.EARLIER_2018_2022: Earlier-period directional check; not a separately selected training protocol.
periods.LATER_2023_2025: Late-period directional check with only 9 call-debit episodes; not labelled a virgin out-of-sample holdout.

limitations: Public historical EOD quote snapshots, not authenticated fills; exact tick timestamps, broker margin, exercise/assignment, fill sequencing and market impact are not verified.
Signal episodes and regime windows are not independent random trials. Wilson intervals are descriptive and may be too narrow.
Episode P&L is noncompounded one-unit P&L, not portfolio CAGR, portfolio MaxDD, or a proven NAV allocation result.
The 1xN and Nx1 PUT Ratio candidates share selected strikes but multiply different legs; large entry terminal tail losses can make every full unit infeasible even when short-period P&L is positive.
The latest option chain date is 2025-12-15; no option result after that date is claimed.
The terminal loss used for illustrative capacity is expiry intrinsic payoff at payoff knots; it does not cap interim liquidation, margin expansion, forced liquidation or gap losses.
